architecture_preference.rule: Try four first. Adopt six only with comparative evidence of a required-motion benefit; a failed finite controller search is not an impossibility proof.

requirements.requirement: Beni-like proportions, central shoulder, folding two-segment legs, internal knee transmission, spring hidden in thigh, slim wheel assembly and enclosed body
requirements.evidence_needed: Reference-linked CAD comparison and internal mechanism view

requirements.requirement: Foldable for storage near Beni size
requirements.target_status: Published reference envelope; posture unreported. Use as folded-package design target, not a measured Beni drawing.
requirements.evidence_needed: Collision-checked transition and complete folded CAD bounds, including purchased hardware

requirements.requirement: Big jump comparable to prior Beni-height objective
requirements.target_status: Engineering target; Beni marketing metric is not defined equivalently
requirements.evidence_needed: Free-body native dynamics, motor limits and stable landing at two timesteps and hardware variants; same CAD mass/inertia

requirements.requirement: Get up from front, back, either side, inverted and diagonal falls
requirements.evidence_needed: Finite randomized start-bank evaluation per family, with stable finish, native validation and no external support. State coverage limits.

requirements.target_status: Earlier user comparison target, not a guaranteed safe operating speed
requirements.evidence_needed: Loaded torque/speed, acceleration/braking, balance and thermal assumptions; no-load rpm is insufficient

requirements.requirement: Enter, sustain and exit one-wheel balance on either wheel
requirements.evidence_needed: Dynamic balance, transition and lateral-disturbance rejection; static COM alignment alone is insufficient

requirements.requirement: Uneven ground, stones and outdoor suspension
requirements.target_status: Initial engineering test grid; report actual supported envelope
requirements.evidence_needed: Independent leg compliance, terrain contacts and repeated traversal with realistic actuator limits; tire/material uncertainty

requirements.requirement: Mostly 3D printed, easy assembly, A1 Mini sized parts, one-piece printed wheels
requirements.evidence_needed: Connected valid CAD solids, print orientation/support review, actual BOM and plate plan

requirements.requirement: Low cost, low complexity and common buyable motors/hardware
requirements.evidence_needed: Dated sourced BOM including drivers, sensing, bearings, transmission and fasteners; incremental four/six motor costs

requirements.requirement: Robust structure, protected internals and jumping load paths
requirements.evidence_needed: Bearing/shaft/fastener load paths, material assumptions, fatigue/landing calculations and a clearly stated physical qualification plan. Never claim unbreakable.

requirements.requirement: Train skills using the actual robot design
requirements.evidence_needed: Versioned CAD/plant identity, realistic sensor/actuator interface, motor and spring identification, randomization, native policy tests
